The PR changes Android gateway readiness and notification node-event delivery so notification events are queued until a gateway connection has completed its connect handshake.

PR surface: Other +811. Total +811 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main exposes currentConnection before the connect RPC completes, forwards notification events without retry, and the gateway rejects non-connect first requests. I did not run a live Android device/emulator in this read-only review, but the PR body reports a real emulator plus Gateway reconnect run on the current fix path.
